name: Munitions Expert - Reloaded
teaser: View hidden attributes of ammo and explosives, with custom background colors based on penetration power values.
description:
Nerd stats on your ammo

Update of IcyClawz’s Munitions Expert (Reboot) for SPT 4.1+.

  • Show hidden stats on all types of ammo, including explosives.

  • Works with modded ammo!

  • Replace background colors with custom ones according to penetration value.

Configuration

F12 BepinEx menu.

Support

Ideally open up a GitHub issue, or reach out to liquidwarp on the SPT or WTT Discord servers!

Installation

  1. Open the downloaded zip file.

  2. Drag the SPT_Runtime folder from the zip file into your SPT folder.

About this mod

This fork and reupload was made in respect of the original Open-Source license, after I did not manage to get hold of the original author for explicit authorization.
